newsitem.title: CANADA: ISIS to market Reuters RBB in U.K.
newsitem.headline: ISIS to market Reuters RBB in U.K.

text.p: International Sales Information Systems Inc said on Tuesday it signed a two-year renewable agreement with Reuters Ltd, a unit of Reuters Holdings Plc, to market Reuters Business Briefing (RBB) in the United Kingdom and Ireland.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
ISIS said it will market RBB by providing links managed by an application developed by ISIS to the contact management package Maximizer for Windows.

The package, Maximizer for Reuters Business Briefing, includes contracts with Reuters for the supply of business information which ensures an ongoing direct relationship between the customer and Reuters.

Maximizer for Reuters Business Briefing is a simple and intelligent way to relate precisely targeted information to customers and prospects within a Maximizer database, ISIS said. It said its software manages the link between the company or individual and the world's most powerful business database, where 10 years of news from over 2,000 publications is instantly available.
The ISIS software also provides access through Reuters Business Briefing to breaking news, financial prices, company data, and a library of news pictures.

ISIS said the delivery of the software and this agreement provides both new and existing users of the Maximizer for Windows contact management application with reliable customer, prospect and competitor information to assist in closing more sales.

The Maximizer for Reuters Business Briefing package will be available through ISIS and key partners from its U.K. reseller network. ISIS will also market training and consultancy services to assist users in developing sales techniques which utilise the information provided by Reuters Business Briefing.
Reuters is the world's leading news and financial information organization.
